parts.label: (ii)
parts.answer: For example, $\mathbf r=7\mathbf j+5\mathbf k+\lambda(\mathbf i-7\mathbf j-4\mathbf k)$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: EITHER: Carry out a complete strategy for finding a point on $l$, the line of intersection — M1. Obtain such a point, e.g. $(0,7,5)$, $(1,0,1)$, $(\frac54,-\frac74,0)$ — A1. EITHER within this route: state two equations for direction vector $a\mathbf i+b\mathbf j+c\mathbf k$, e.g. $3a+b-c=0$ and $a-b+2c=0$ — B1. Solve for one ratio, e.g. $a:b$ — M1. Obtain $a:b:c=1:-7:-4$, or equivalent — A1. State a correct answer, e.g. $\mathbf r=7\mathbf j+5\mathbf k+\lambda(\mathbf i-7\mathbf j-4\mathbf k)$ — A1 FT. OR1 within this route: obtain second point $(1,0,1)$ — B1; subtract vectors and obtain direction vector — M1; obtain $-\mathbf i+7\mathbf j+4\mathbf k$, or equivalent — A1; state e.g. $\mathbf r=\mathbf i+\mathbf k+\lambda(-\mathbf i+7\mathbf j+4\mathbf k)$ — A1 FT. OR2 within this route: attempt vector product of normals — M1; obtain two correct components — A1; obtain $\mathbf i-7\mathbf j-4\mathbf k$, or equivalent — A1; state e.g. $\mathbf r=7\mathbf j+5\mathbf k+\lambda(\mathbf i-7\mathbf j-4\mathbf k)$ — A1 FT. OR1 main route: express one variable in terms of a second — M1; obtain e.g. $y=7-7x$ — A1; express third variable in terms of second — M1; obtain e.g. $z=5-4x$ — A1; form vector equation — M1; obtain e.g. $\mathbf r=7\mathbf j+5\mathbf k+\lambda(\mathbf i-7\mathbf j-4\mathbf k)$ — A1 FT. OR2 main route: express one variable in terms of a second — M1; obtain e.g. $z=5-4x$ — A1; express same variable in terms of third — M1; obtain e.g. $z=(7+4y)/7$ — A1; form vector equation — M1; obtain e.g. $\mathbf r=\frac54\mathbf i-\frac74\mathbf j+\lambda(-\frac14\mathbf i+\frac74\mathbf j+\mathbf k)$ — A1 FT. [Total: 6]
